outcome: Blood loss (from placental delivery to 2 hours postpartum)
Blood loss (from end of LSCS to 2 hours postpartum)
Blood loss (from placental delivery to end of LSCS)
cohort: The study included 100 women undergoing elective or emergency primary caesarean section at term (37-41 weeks).
finding: Tranexamic acid significantly reduced blood loss from placental delivery to 2 hours postpartum and from the end of LSCS to 2 hours postpartum without significant adverse effects.
mod_finding: The study's primary finding is that tranexamic acid effectively reduces blood loss during and after lower segment caesarean section (LSCS), thereby directly relating to the surgical mode of birth.
